value.body: Social media executives run the day-to-day presence of a brand, publication or organisation on social platforms. Digital agencies, media houses, brands and NGOs hire them. A day involves planning a content calendar, writing posts, working with designers and video editors, and responding to the audience.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BJMC, BBA, BA or any graduate with a portfolio

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Platform dashboards, scheduling tools, Canva-type design apps

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually start in a digital agency or a media house's social team, often after an internship. A sample content calendar or accounts you have grown help show the skill.

value.title: At a glance
items: Posts and responses can be needed outside office hours.
Platform rules and formats change often.
Next steps: social media manager, content strategist, or digital marketing roles.
